notes: Three real-length tests of 60 (IDs 22901-22903) at the real 60%: ceil(0.6 x 60) = 36. Pools are 3x per-test count plus spares (2 each, 4 in economia), the last items of each pool, 20 in all, training-only. Five topic sets 22901-22905 (32, 46, 49, 33, 40; all 200 items) + 3 tests = 8 dashboard steps. Per-test weights are Tigertest's (IMT publishes none), following Annex I of Directive 2003/59/EC as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/645 (transposed by Decreto-Lei 126/2009 as republished by Decreto-Lei 102-C/2020).
